demos.title: Agency delivery lab
demos.description: Explore six synthetic processes in 2D and 3D and switch between them: the in-house agency pipeline with shared resources, parallel design and rework, an agile vendor pipeline with CI/CD automation, an order fulfilment line with robots, software systems and a human spot-check, customer and user journeys through an online shop and an app onboarding, and a loan application converted from BPMN 2.0 and BPSim with an inclusive gateway, multi-instance work, a call activity and an SLA escalation.
